caseNameFull: Christopher MARLOWE, Applicant v. James M. LEBLANC, Secretary, Louisiana Department of Public Safety and Corrections

opinions.text: Application to vacate stay presented to Justice Alito and by him referred to the Court denied. Nothing in this order should be construed to preclude Applicant from filing a grievance setting out specifically the relief he requests be provided to him in the prison, and in the event that such request is filed, it should be decided promptly.
